title: Winter Wonderland
description: Get that cozy winter feel by turning the entire world into a snow-filled landscape!
body:
![Winter Wonderland Banner](https://github.com/Kraggle09/winter-wonderland/blob/main/assets/title_slim.png?raw=true)
**Get that cozy winter feel by turning the entire world into a snow-filled landscape!**  
There's no escape from the snow! It even snows in the desert!

### Changes this pack makes:
- Lowers temperature to 0 for all vanilla biomes
- Enables rainfall on all vanilla biomes

### Compatibility:
- This pack is not compatible with any world generation mod that modifies vanilla biomes.
- It can probably be used with mods that add new biomes, but they won't be frozen.
